baselineChecks: The same natural-language prompt does not ask the user for scope names.
The Link scope covers every VFS-visible root the App defines.
The App shows one human-readable consent, not a scope-name question.
No VFS_* errors, no search_budget_exceeded, no user round trip for missing scope.
vfs_connect succeeds and returns correct visibleRoots.
The final answer's visibility statement matches visibleRoots or a real /vfs listing.
trace.md, conversation.md and system_prompt.md are reachable on demand.
driftNote: Tool order and search queries may vary. Compare scope coverage, errors, visibleRoots, final visibility statement and foreground dependency. This is a v1 Link baseline; create a separate case after Link v2 and App .71.
